series.notes: Instituted by DM Tesoro 22/02/2000 (from the day after GU publication; Poste table gives 05/03/2000). Confirmed 30-year series like Q-X: years 1-20 capitalized annually "al lordo dell'imposta sostitutiva del 12,50%"; years 21-30 simple interest at 0.50% until the end of the 30th calendar year after the year of issue. Paper forms of earlier series issued from that date count as Y (art. 3). Denominations in euro (50-5,000) and lire while stocks lasted. Bimester accrual within years 1-20 per Poste 30-year table footnote (decree text itself mentions only annual capitalization). Same mechanics as X; no official coefficient table available.

Instituted by DM Tesoro 30/06/2000 (Poste table: 16/07/2000-27/12/2000). 30-year series: years 1-20 capitalized annually gross of the 12.50% tax; years 21-30 simple interest 0.50% to the end of the 30th calendar year after issue. Earlier-series forms issued from the start date count as Z (art. 3). Ceased 27/12/2000 when DM 19/12/2000 (art. 11) introduced 20-year series A1 and made Z no longer subscribable.

Rates and 20y gross coefficient from the series own Foglio Informativo (Tabella A/B); also identical to the Poste storico table. Interest accrues per completed bimester (rate/6, simple within the year, 360/360), capitalized annually (compound), gross of tax; nothing paid if redeemed within 12 months; no interest after the 20th anniversary of subscription. FI: maturity "alla scadenza del ventesimo anno successivo alla data di sottoscrizione" (20th anniversary); DM 19/12/2000 art. 14 allows redemption until the end of the 20th year after issue (prescription 10y after maturity). Net coefficients printed in FI = 1+(gross-1)*0.875 (e.g. A4 20y net 2.58252324). First 20-year ordinary series (DM 19/12/2000), replacing 30-year series Z.

No gaps among the new series: windows contiguous from Y 2000-03-05 to TF120A250624 (open-ended, issueTo null = still on sale at 2026-10-18).
coverageCheck: Combined with the previously verified series (Q-X, A8, A9, B1, B5, B9, B12-B14, B16, B19, B28, B29, B39-B41, B45, B50, B51, B56, B60, B67, B73, B75, B81, B83, B87-B89, B92, B98, B99) issue windows are contiguous from 1986-07-01 to today (TF120A250624 open-ended).
productNaming: Product is always "Buono Fruttifero Postale Ordinario". Codes: Y, Z (2000, 30-year), A1-A9 (2000-2004), B1-B99 (2004-01/2013), C01-C19 (02/2013-02/2016), then from 18/02/2016 the CDP code format TF120A<YYMMDD> (TF = tasso fisso, 120 = ordinary 20-year product, YYMMDD = start of conditions). Note: issue windows for C-series and TF-codes are no longer monthly; a new series starts only when conditions change.
methodVerification: Formula coef(m)=prod_{y<floor(m/12)}(1+r_y)*(1+r_next*floor((m mod 12)/2)/6), net=1+(coef-1)*0.875, reproduced the official 20-year gross coefficient to 8 decimals for every series where it was available (A1-A7, all B, C01-C12, C14, C15, C17-C19, TF120A170420/170626/180122/190910/200508/201106/220609/220706/221027/230124/230606/231228/241011), plus year-end coefficients at 1/5/10/15y for several and intra-year bimester gross+net coefficients for TF120A250624 (current series). The method is unchanged through 2026.
openQuestions: C13 (10/03/2014-09/04/2014), C16 (20/01/2015-22/02/2015) and TF120A160218 (18/02/2016-19/04/2017): own FI/SdS not retrieved; rates come from the Poste storico 2014-2019 table whose rows are unlabelled. Row order mapped chronologically; this mapping was confirmed for the other 11 of 14 rows, so risk is low but not zero.

TF120A231005 (05/10/2023-27/12/2023): official Tabella A/B not extractable; years 16-20 (5/6/7/8/9.5%) inferred from secondary source + exact match of official gross effective yields. Years 1-15 equal TF120A230606 (exact TER match). Confirm with the FI PDF (cdp.it SdS_e_FI_BFP_Ord_05-10-2023.pdf) if possible.

Y and Z: bimester accrual within years 1-20 assumed (Poste footnote); DM text mentions only annual capitalization gross of tax. Years 21-30 simple-interest base assumed = value at end of year 20 (same open question as Q-X).
B74 end date: storico table says 30/12/2010, FI listing says 31/12/2010 (31/12 used).

A-series maturity: FI says 20th year after subscription (anniversary); DM 19/12/2000 art. 14 phrasing "entro la fine del ventesimo anno successivo a quello di emissione" refers to the redemption deadline; anniversary assumed for interest cessation (consistent with Tabella B ending at 20y 0m).

TF120A180914, TF120A190322, TF120A190628, TF120A200717: official 20y Tabella B coefficient not extractable (formulaMatches null), though rates are from official Tabella A/SdS and the formula reproduces the official effective-yield examples.
